    Product Details

    Say good-bye to chemical filled moisturizers, and say hello to nature's intended skincare. We make every batch of our Honey Tallow Balm with the highest quality Grass Fed Beef Tallow, Olive Oil, and Raw Honey. Through a meticulous rendering and clarifying process, we produce a pure tallow for our balms, ensuring the highest standard of excellence in every jar.

    Benefits

    Skin Support: Grass-fed Beef tallow is renowned for its nutrient-rich properties. Packed with vitamins A, D, E, and K, our balm provides essential nutrients for optimal skin health without the need for added fillers or artificial ingredients.

    Encourages Healthy Skin: Experience whole-body moisture as our balm effortlessly hydrates your face, hands, feet, and beyond. Absorbing easily without any greasy or gritty feel, it's suitable for all skin types, offering relief for acne, dry skin, and sensitive skin.

    Premium Quality: At Terra Lotus, we're dedicated to delivering skincare solutions that prioritize both effectiveness and sustainability. Our small-batch production process utilizes only the finest organic ingredients, ensuring a product you can trust.

    How To Use

    Terra Lotus tallow moisturizer is safe and effective on all skin types, so you can feel comfortable moisturizing anywhere! Most users love it for their face, arms, and any dry or wrinkled areas!

    Who Is This For?

    Terra Lotus is made from 100% organic ingredients and is great for all skin types! We take pride in using only the highest quality tallow, olive oil, beeswax, and honey!

    *Do not use if you are allergic to any ingredients on the label, product is not intended to treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

      Born on the Farm. Tested by Science. Made by Family.

      Our balm is developed in collaboration with formulators in cosmetic chemistry, traditional skincare, and integrative medicine - combining whole-ingredient simplicity with modern testing standards.

      Tallow-based balm promotes skin barrier health and hydration

      The skin can become dry or cracked when the skin barrier is weakened. That’s why I am such a fan of the tallow in this Honey Balm. Grass-fed beef tallow contains fatty acids, including oleic and palmitic acid, which are similar to those the skin produces naturally. A review of dermatology literature suggests tallow may work with the skin’s natural structure rather than just coating the surface. This may offer support for the skin barrier over time. A healthy skin barrier matters for patients because it is one of the body’s first defenses against moisture loss and environmental irritants. When combined with olive oil and raw honey, as it is here, I feel confident suggesting this balm to patients wanting to support their skin’s hydration and resilience.

      Dr. Kevin Kia · Dermatologist

          ✦ Got questions? We've got answers

          Frequently Asked Questions

          Yes. Tallow is bioidentical to the lipids in human skin, making it especially effective for the hormonal skin changes that come with menopause — dryness, thinning, and loss of elasticity.

          Most tallow balms are made from generic beef fat. Ours uses grass-fed, grass-finished suet — the purest fat from around the kidneys — which is richer in fat-soluble vitamins and has a lighter, less greasy texture.

          No. A small amount — about the size of a pea — is enough for your whole face. It absorbs quickly and leaves skin feeling smooth, not oily.

          Yes, and it works beautifully as a buffer. Apply your active first, let it absorb, then layer Terra Lotus on top to seal moisture and reduce irritation.

          Absolutely. Many customers use it on their neck, décolletage, hands, elbows, and anywhere else that needs extra moisture. One jar goes a long way.

          Most customers notice softer, calmer skin within 3–5 days. Significant improvements in texture and barrier strength typically show up within 2–4 weeks of daily use.

          Our formula contains only tallow, lavender essential oil, and beeswax — all ingredients considered safe for topical use during pregnancy. We always recommend checking with your healthcare provider if you have any concerns.

          Our Vision

          Family-owned and made in the USA, Terra Lotus was built on one belief: if we wouldn’t use it on our own family, we wouldn’t make it a product. Every jar is handcrafted from four whole ingredients — no fillers, no shortcuts, no compromises. Our goal is simple — give people a cleaner alternative to the products that have let them down, starting with what goes on their skin every day.
